evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We further introduce StreamFun3D, a benchmark derived from real-world 3D scenes that evaluates response timing and grounding across four evidence settings: Current, History, Future, and Unobserved, together with StreamIoU, a metric that credits a mask only when the response is timely and grounded in a valid source frame.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: The model scores the visual patches of the frames it reads: their combined support, weighed against a wait option, decides when to respond, and the highest-scoring patch selects the frame to ground in.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We adapt offline 3D affordance grounding methods and build external-decider baselines that pair vision-language models with our mask decoder.
